annotations.text:
Back on the brand book: warm ink, amber, Instrument Serif, Kome.
Five sections, down from nine. Liquid Glass is gone entirely — the two selling points are typed RPC and the agent tooling, and they get a section each, side by side with the code that proves them.
Apps: Anko and Washi only. Both need real one-liners from you — the copy is bracketed, not invented.
